commentary: Despite the sharp 1,000-point headline index surge past 23,800, a breadth score of 42 signals an underlying market divergence, corroborating the deterministic WEAK gate. Under Stan Weinstein's stage discipline and William O'Neil's market-direction rules, head-fakes and selective rallies are common when market internals lag price thrusts. Institutional sponsorship remains narrowly concentrated rather than broad-based. Jesse Livermore taught that speculative capital must respect the general trend above individual patterns. Therefore, despite constructive individual bases, disciplined operators maintain low risk exposure, enforce strict stop-losses, and demand genuine CANSLIM earnings acceleration before expanding progressive exposure.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

21STCENMGM.technical: Clearing a 20-session pivot to fresh 52-week highs on 3.69x average volume confirms Stage 2 momentum. Moving averages are properly stacked above the rising 200-day line, showing solid Darvas box expansion.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Turnaround from negative quarterly operations with ₹10 Cr revenue, but annual ROE of -70% and zero institutional ownership fail O'Neil's institutional sponsorship and quality threshold.
21STCENMGM.risk: Thesis breaks below ₹51.98 stop; tight liquidity and micro-cap volatility demand instant exit on failure.

63MOONS.technical: Constructing a tight consolidation within 1.5% of its 20-session high. Price holds well above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD confirming positive momentum along aligned swing lows.
63MOONS.fundamental: Operating profitability remains erratic with recurring negative core operating margins and an ROE near -2%. Weak top-line growth (+5%) fails CANSLIM criteria despite an almost debt-free balance sheet.
63MOONS.risk: Fails on a drop beneath ₹859.60; violate stop immediately given decelerating underlying earnings.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Forming a double-bottom structure with price supported above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Long lower wick signals intra-day accumulation, while RSI at 56 indicates unexhausted momentum.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction of 55% YoY and falling quarterly profit margin fail O'Neil's C-criterion. Weak ROCE of ~5.6% highlights low capital efficiency.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Stop at ₹103.98; exit immediately if the double-bottom support cracks.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Consolidating within 1.5% of a 20-day breakout pivot, maintaining trend structure above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 63 and positive MACD show constructive relative strength.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Revenue grew 19% YoY, but net earnings contracted 7% YoY due to margin pressures. Modest ROCE (~12%) and debt-to-equity of 0.47 fail CANSLIM's 25% profit expansion requirement.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Strict stop at ₹420.75; failure to absorb supply at the pivot invalidates setup.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Forming an orderly double bottom above rising 50-day and 200-day moving averages. Clean neckline pressure with RSI 53 and positive MACD confirms constructive contraction and institutional absorption.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM profile with Q2 FY27 EPS jumping 180% YoY on 46% sales growth. Operating margins expanded to 22.2% driven by CDMO/Xanthine demand, supporting leadership characteristics despite moderate leverage.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Cut quickly if price breaks below ₹914.95 swing low, signaling pattern breakdown.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Trading within 1.5% of 20-day highs in an established Stage 2 trend, supported above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 66 and positive MACD reflect consistent relative strength.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Robust port volume expansion drives 24% revenue growth and 17% profit acceleration. Stellar ~58% operating margins and healthy 16% ROE back strong institutional backing, offset by elevated leverage.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Violated if price slips below ₹1774.37 stop; exit immediately to preserve capital.
